tlmvision.screen.vision.title: Vision model
book.tlmvision.third_eye.name: Third Eye
book.tlmvision.third_eye.intro: A bauble that allows the owner and maid to share their sight.$(br2)After being equipped, the owner can borrow the maid's sight and control where she looks. The maid can also receive a view shared by her owner and describe it in chat.
tlmvision.config.title: Touhou Little Maid: Vision
tlmvision.config.chat_improvements.detai: Client-side improvements to Touhou Little Maid's chat screens: a drag bar for the history that opens at the newest message and keeps its place, plus a context counter that shows the last request's size against the history compress limit and lifetime spend.
